days.title: An empty garden bed by a stream
days.lore: Dark soil, a trickle of water and one question: what will the weather in Heilbronn make of it?

days.title: A young lavender on the little hill at the back
days.lore: On a hot late-September afternoon the first seedling goes in: a sprig of lavender on the little hill, where the sun lingers longest.

days.title: Watering the young lavender
days.lore: The stream shrinks to a thread in the warm afternoon, so the gardener carries a can up the little hill for the thirsty lavender.

days.title: An oak sapling in the middle of the garden at the back
days.lore: October begins with the stream bed dry and warm, and an acorn goes into the ground at the back of the meadow to wait for rain.

days.title: Tulip bulbs in the middle of the garden
days.lore: The first rain in days softens the dry meadow, and a tulip bulb is tucked into the damp earth to sleep until spring.

days.title: Listening to the rain
days.lore: A quick shower and a long golden afternoon do the work today, and the gardener just sits on the warm grass and listens to the stream filling again.

days.title: An apple tree sapling on the far side of the stream at the front
days.lore: Morning mist lifts into a mild golden day, and across the stream a little apple tree is set in the ground, a promise of blossom for some far-off spring.

days.title: A beehive on the little hill at the front
days.lore: On a warm, bright October day a beehive is set on the little hill near the lavender, ready for the bees of spring.

days.title: Watering the young apple tree
days.lore: With the stream bed dry once more, the gardener carries water across the empty channel to the young apple tree on the far side.

days.title: Tulip bulbs in the middle of the garden
days.lore: Under a warm, hazy October sky a second tulip bulb goes in beside the first, and the middle of the garden begins to look like a flower bed.

days.title: Watering the young oak
days.lore: The stream bed has lain dry for days, so the gardener tips a full can around the young oak and watches the dust turn dark.

days.title: A willow sapling on the west bank of the stream
days.lore: Grey rain and a gusty wind bring the trickle back to the stream, and a willow cutting is pressed into the soft west bank to drink from it.

days.title: Watering the young willow
days.lore: Under a low grey sky and a cold wind, the gardener settles the new willow cutting with a can of water so its roots take hold before winter.

days.title: A pine sapling on the little hill at the back
days.lore: Between bright spells and brisk showers a little pine is set at the back of the hill, where one day it will stand dark green against the winter sky.

days.title: Stepping stones across the stream
days.lore: On a grey, blustery day the gardener lays flat stones across the shallow stream, so the apple tree on the far side is only a few dry steps away.

days.title: Watering the young pine
days.lore: A clear, still October day after the morning mist, and the gardener climbs the little hill to give the young pine its first long drink.

days.title: Tulip bulbs in the middle of the garden
days.lore: The nights are turning cold, so the gardener chooses a hardy tulip bulb and tucks it in beside the other two to wait out the winter.

days.title: A garden shed at the back
days.lore: With eight plants now in its care, the garden earns a little wooden shed at the back of the meadow, its door open to a mild, showery afternoon.

days.title: A willow sapling on the east bank of the stream
days.lore: On a calm golden afternoon a second willow cutting goes into the east bank, so that one day two green crowns will lean toward each other across the stream.
